master_output.idea:
**Core idea:** Introduce a curriculum learning schedule where the model is first trained on the easiest-to-classify examples (lowest loss) and gradually incorporates harder ones over epochs, with an epoch-wise ramping of the hardest 10% into the batch mix, to improve convergence speed and final accuracy.

**Non-trivial crux:** The hardest examples must be injected only after the model has some signal, since feeding them too early (before the easy set is somewhat solved) actively degrades learning and accuracy — so the schedule must be carefully phased with a warmup on the easy set before any hard examples enter the loss, and a small fraction of the hardest should be sampled per epoch rather than full inclusion.
